name: Biofilm Development — Live Topology
description: Fig 10.2 (biofilm) as a genuine place-graph rewrite: a founder cell colonizes (sibling cell nodes added one at a time up to capacity), then the mature community secretes extracellular matrix (an ECM node per cell). Running it adds place-graph nodes at runtime — steppable topology for the loom run/animate feature. The biofilm interface (a tree[node] community) grows from one cell into a structured multicellular collective.

capacity.description: Carrying capacity — how many cells the biofilm colonizes to.

grow_every.description: Time between cell-division events during colonization.
